1283-1651-4772-7824-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Doubling Season and Bard.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-4772-7824-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

574-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
574-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.
574-4694-4802-7306.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

5571-6495-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5571-6495-6922--6.description:
Use Coveted Falcon to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
5571-6495-6922--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7725.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2724-3987-7309.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Don & Leo. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

153-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
You have at least two cards in hand.
153-4772-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Jolrael
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3368-6747-6974.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
3368-6747-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {U}{R} due to Sami. Choose its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any other mode as desired.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Sami, copying Ashling's Command with the fourth mode targeting yourself and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating two Treasure tokens and performing the action of the other chosen mode.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-2750-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
1978-2750-4188.description:
Cause Accomplished Alchemist to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-2921-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2523-2921-5560.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1429-2829-4452-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2829-4452-5402.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

2558-2899-3698-3764.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield as a 1/1 creature due to Kaervek, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Pincher.
Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

1913-2558-2641-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 black creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1913-2558-2641-4659.description:
Cause a 2/2 black creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1 creature due to Urborg Shambler.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the creature.
Imotekh triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Imotekh trigger, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens that enter the battlefield as 1/1 creatures due to Urborg Shambler.
Repeat from step 2.

1030-1636-2034-3433.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1636-2034-3433.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hornet Queen, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
The Insect tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm four times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

1953-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1953-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2050-4222-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
Market Festival attached to a Forest you control.
2050-4222-4878.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {U}{G} and one mana of any color.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.

215-1741-4191.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
215-1741-4191.description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries without paying its mana cost.
Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, untapping two lands that can produce {1}{G}.
Activate those two lands by tapping those, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Cloud of Faeries to your hand and giving Temur Sabertooth indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.
